title: पञ्चत्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks by what deeds a man is purified from sin and Vyasa describes the sins of killing, theft and others, and gives examples such as Uddalaka's son. He says some acts, though outwardly wrong, are not sins in certain cases.
summary.kn: ಯಾವ ಕರ್ಮಗಳಿಂದ ಮನುಷ್ಯ ಪಾಪದಿಂದ ಶುದ್ಧನಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ವ್ಯಾಸ ಕೊಲೆ, ಕಳ್ಳತನ ಮೊದಲಾದ ಪಾಪಗಳನ್ನು ವರ್ಣಿಸಿ ಉದ್ದಾಲಕನ ಮಗನಂತಹ ಉದಾಹರಣೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಕೆಲವು ಕೃತ್ಯಗಳು ಕೆಲವು ಸಂದರ್ಭಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಪವಲ್ಲವೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि किन कर्मों से मनुष्य पाप से शुद्ध होता है, और व्यास हत्या, चोरी आदि पापों का वर्णन कर उद्दालक के पुत्र जैसे उदाहरण देते हैं। वे कहते हैं कि कुछ कर्म बाहर से अनुचित होकर भी विशेष स्थितियों में पाप नहीं होते।
summary.te: ఏ కర్మలతో మనిషి పాపం నుండి శుద్ధి పొందుతాడని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు; వ్యాసుడు హత్య, దొంగతనం మొదలైన పాపాలను వర్ణించి ఉద్దాలకుని కుమారుని వంటి ఉదాహరణలు ఇస్తాడు. కొన్ని కృత్యాలు కొన్ని సందర్భాల్లో పాపం కావని అంటాడు.
summary.ta: எந்தச் செயல்களால் மனிதன் பாவத்திலிருந்து தூய்மையடைகிறான் என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, வியாசர் கொலை, திருட்டு முதலிய பாவங்களை விவரித்து உத்தாலகனின் மகன் போன்ற எடுத்துக்காட்டுகளைத் தருகிறார். சில செயல்கள் சில சூழல்களில் பாவமாகா என்கிறார்.
summary.ml: മനുഷ്യൻ ഏതു പ്രവൃത്തികളാൽ പാപത്തിൽനിന്ന് ശുദ്ധനാകുമെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു; കൊലപാതകം, മോഷണം തുടങ്ങിയ പാപങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ച് വ്യാസൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു, ഉദ്ദാലകന്റെ പുത്രന്റെ ഉദാഹരണവും നൽകുന്നു. ചില പ്രവൃത്തികൾ പുറമേ തെറ്റായി തോന്നിയാലും ചില സാഹചര്യങ്ങളിൽ പാപമല്ലെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.35; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
कानि कृत्वेह कर्माणि प्रायश्चित्तीयते नरः ।
किं कृत्वा चैव मुच्येत तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥

meaning.en: Tell me, grandfather, by doing what deeds does a man need atonement here, and by doing what is he freed?

verses.text: व्यास उवाच

meaning.en: Vyasa said:

verses.text:
अकुर्वन्विहितं कर्म प्रतिषिद्धानि चाचरन् ।
प्रायश्चित्तीयते ह्येवं नरो मिथ्या च वर्तयन् ॥

meaning.en: A man needs atonement when he fails to do the prescribed act, does what is forbidden, and lives by falsehood.

verses.text:
सूर्येणाभ्युदितो यश्च ब्रह्मचारी भवत्युत ।
तथा सूर्याभिनिर्मुक्तः कुनखी श्यावदन्नपि ॥

meaning.en: Also one who is a celibate student but is found asleep at sunrise or sunset, and one with deformed nails or black teeth.

verses.text:
परिवित्तिः परिवेत्ता ब्रह्मोज्झो यश्च कुत्सकः ।
दिधिषूपतिस्तथा यः स्यादग्रेदिधिषुरेव च ॥

meaning.en: The younger brother who marries before his elder, the elder who stays unmarried while the younger weds, one who abandons the Veda, one who slanders, the husband of a twice-married woman, and the man who first married such a woman.

verses.text:
अवकीर्णी भवेद्यश्च द्विजातिवधकस्तथा ।
अतीर्थे ब्रह्मणस्त्यागी तीर्थे चाप्रतिपादकः ॥

meaning.en: One who breaks his celibate vow, one who kills a twice-born, one who gives the Veda to the unfit and does not give it to the worthy.

verses.text:
ग्रामयाजी च कौन्तेय राज्ञश्च परिविक्रयी ।
शूद्रस्त्रीवधको यश्च पूर्वः पूर्वस्तु गर्हितः ॥

meaning.en: Son of Kunti, a village priest, one who sells a king's property, and one who kills a Shudra woman, each earlier one in this list being the more blameworthy.

verses.text:
वृथापशुसमालम्भी वनदाहस्य कारकः ।
अनृतेनोपचर्ता च प्रतिरोद्धा गुरोस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: One who slaughters animals pointlessly, one who sets the forest on fire, one who serves with falsehood, and one who obstructs his teacher.

verses.text:
यश्चाग्नीनपविध्येत तथैव ब्रह्मविक्रयी ।
एतान्येनांसि सर्वाणि व्युत्क्रान्तसमयश्च यः ॥

meaning.en: One who casts away the sacred fires, and one who sells the Veda; all these are sinners, as is one who has broken an agreement.

verses.text:
अकार्याण्यपि वक्ष्यामि यानि तानि निबोध मे ।
लोकवेदविरुद्धानि तान्येकाग्रमनाः शृणु ॥

meaning.en: Now I will also tell you the acts that must not be done; listen to them with a single mind, for they are against the world and the Veda.

verses.text:
स्वधर्मस्य परित्यागः परधर्मस्य च क्रिया ।
अयाज्ययाजनं चैव तथाभक्ष्यस्य भक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: Abandoning one's own dharma, practicing another's dharma, performing sacrifices for those unfit for them, and eating what may not be eaten.

verses.text:
शरणागतसंत्यागो भृत्यस्याभरणं तथा ।
रसानां विक्रयश्चापि तिर्यग्योनिवधस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Abandoning one who has come for refuge, failing to support one's dependents, selling liquids and juices, and killing animals born in animal wombs.

verses.text:
आधानादीनि कर्माणि शक्तिमान्न करोति यः ।
अप्रयच्छंश्च सर्वाणि नित्यं देयानि भारत ॥

meaning.en: One who, though able, does not perform the rites beginning with the setting up of the fires, and does not give all that must always be given, Bharata.

verses.text:
दक्षिणानामदानं च ब्राह्मणस्वाभिमर्शनम् ।
सर्वाण्येतान्यकार्याणि प्राहुर्धर्मविदो जनाः ॥

meaning.en: Not giving the sacrificial fees and touching a brahmin's property by force; the knowers of dharma call all these things that must not be done.

verses.text:
पित्रा विभजते पुत्रो यश्च स्याद्गुरुतल्पगः ।
अप्रजायन्नधर्मेण भवत्याधर्मिको जनः ॥

meaning.en: A son who divides the inheritance while his father lives, one who violates his teacher's bed, and a man who remains without children by wrongful conduct becomes unrighteous.

verses.text:
उक्तान्येतानि कर्माणि विस्तरेणेतरेण च ।
यानि कुर्वन्नकुर्वंश्च प्रायश्चित्तीयते जनः ॥

meaning.en: These deeds have been told in detail and in outline, which when done or left undone make a person need atonement.

verses.text:
एतान्येव तु कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि मानवान् ।
येषु येषु निमित्तेषु न लिम्पन्त्यथ तच्छृणु ॥

meaning.en: Now hear the cases in which these very acts, done for certain reasons, do not stain people.

verses.text:
प्रगृह्य शस्त्रमायान्तमपि वेदान्तगं रणे ।
जिघांसन्तं निहत्याजौ न तेन ब्रह्महा भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: If someone raises a weapon in battle against you and means to kill you, even a master of Vedanta, and you kill him in the fight, you do not become a killer of a brahmin.

verses.text:
अपि चाप्यत्र कौन्तेय मन्त्रो वेदेषु पठ्यते ।
वेदप्रमाणविहितं तं धर्मं प्रब्रवीमि ते ॥

meaning.en: Kunti's son, on this point a verse is recited in the Vedas; I will tell you that dharma as laid down on Vedic authority.

verses.text:
अपेतं ब्राह्मणं वृत्ताद्यो हन्यादाततायिनम् ।
न तेन ब्रह्महा स स्यान्मन्युस्तं मन्युमृच्छति ॥

meaning.en: One who kills a brahmin who has fallen from good conduct and attacks with murderous intent does not become a killer of a brahmin; anger meets that anger.

verses.text:
प्राणात्यये तथाज्ञानादाचरन्मदिरामपि ।
अचोदितो धर्मपरः पुनः संस्कारमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: One who is dutiful and, when life is in danger, or from ignorance, drinks liquor without being urged, deserves purification again.

verses.text:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं कौन्तेयाभक्ष्यभक्षणम् ।
प्रायश्चित्तविधानेन सर्वमेतेन शुध्यति ॥

meaning.en: All this about eating what may not be eaten has been told to you, Kunti's son; by the rule of atonement all of it is cleansed.

verses.text:
गुरुतल्पं हि गुर्वर्थे न दूषयति मानवम् ।
उद्दालकः श्वेतकेतुं जनयामास शिष्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Going to a teacher's bed for the teacher's sake does not defile a man; Uddalaka begot Shvetaketu through his pupil.

verses.text:
स्तेयं कुर्वंस्तु गुर्वर्थमापत्सु न निबध्यते ।
बहुशः कामकारेण न चेद्यः संप्रवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: One who steals for his teacher's sake in distress is not bound, provided he does not act repeatedly out of desire.

verses.text:
अन्यत्र ब्राह्मणस्वेभ्य आददानो न दुष्यति ।
स्वयमप्राशिता यश्च न स पापेन लिप्यते ॥

meaning.en: One who takes from others except from brahmins' property is not defiled, and one who has not himself eaten is not stained by sin.

verses.text:
प्राणत्राणेऽनृतं वाच्यमात्मनो वा परस्य वा ।
गुर्वर्थे स्त्रीषु चैव स्याद्विवाहकरणेषु च ॥

meaning.en: To save a life, one's own or another's, falsehood may be spoken, and also for a teacher, for women, and at the arranging of marriages.

verses.text:
नावर्तते व्रतं स्वप्ने शुक्रमोक्षे कथंचन ।
आज्यहोमः समिद्धेऽग्नौ प्रायश्चित्तं विधीयते ॥

meaning.en: A vow is not broken by a nocturnal emission in a dream; the rule of atonement is an offering of ghee into a kindled fire.

verses.text:
पारिवित्त्यं च पतिते नास्ति प्रव्रजिते तथा ।
भिक्षिते पारदार्यं च न तद्धर्मस्य दूषकम् ॥

meaning.en: Marrying before an elder brother is no fault when the elder is fallen or has gone forth as an ascetic, and union with another's wife when it is begging for a son does not harm dharma.

verses.text:
वृथापशुसमालम्भं नैव कुर्यान्न कारयेत् ।
अनुग्रहः पशूणां हि संस्कारो विधिचोदितः ॥

meaning.en: One should not slaughter animals pointlessly or have it done; the consecration of animals is a favor to them, as the rule prescribes.

verses.text:
अनर्हे ब्राह्मणे दत्तमज्ञानात्तन्न दूषकम् ।
सकारणं तथा तीर्थेऽतीर्थे वा प्रतिपादनम् ॥

meaning.en: A gift given to an unworthy brahmin out of ignorance is not a fault, nor is a gift given with good reason, whether to a fitting person or not.

verses.text:
स्त्रियस्तथापचारिण्यो निष्कृतिः स्याददूषिका ।
अपि सा पूयते तेन न तु भर्ता प्रदुष्यते ॥

meaning.en: Women who have strayed have an atonement that is not defiling; she is purified by it, and her husband is not defiled.

verses.text:
तत्त्वं ज्ञात्वा तु सोमस्य विक्रयः स्याददूषकः ।
असमर्थस्य भृत्यस्य विसर्गः स्याददोषवान् ।
वनदाहो गवामर्थे क्रियमाणो न दूषकः ॥

meaning.en: Selling soma for its real purpose is no fault; releasing a servant who cannot work is without blame; burning a forest done for the sake of cows is no fault.

verses.text:
उक्तान्येतानि कर्माणि यानि कुर्वन्न दुष्यति ।
प्रायश्चित्तानि वक्ष्यामि विस्तरेणैव भारत ॥

meaning.en: These acts have been told, which do not defile when done; now I will tell the atonements in detail, Bharata.
